name: Crossroads: Burth no longer stands inside the hut wall (#8216)
contract: #8216 reported Burth (creature guid 9950044, entry 342828, Wildcard season event 194) partly inside a wall beside the Crossroads wyvern roost. #7212 had moved him to (-446.847, -2583.061, 96.055), 0.6-1.1 yd from the leaning east wall of the patch-WB1 Orchut.wmo hut. He now stands just outside that wall at (-443.847, -2580.061, 96.915), on the ground and at least 1 yd clear of every vmap model. The scenario activates event 194 to spawn Burth and restores its original state during teardown, including after a failed assertion.
